title: Motion Verbs 2: ехать vs ездить
description: The transport pair. Ехать = single one-way trip in progress, by some vehicle. Ездить = round-trip, habit, or general claim about motion by vehicle.
descriptionRussian: Транспортная пара. Ехать — однонаправленная поездка в процессе. Ездить — туда и обратно, привычка или общее утверждение о передвижении.
intro: The same split again, this time for traveling by vehicle. Having learned the distinction once, you get this pair almost free, which is exactly the point: the pattern is the thing to own, not the individual verbs. Two details worth catching. One form has a consonant change in the я-form, and the means of transport gets named with a preposition rather than built into the verb.
rules: Ехать = single one-way trip in progress, by transport. Present: еду, едешь, едет, едем, едете, едут. Past: ехал / ехала / ехало / ехали.
Ездить = round-trip, habit, or general claim about motion by transport. Present: езжу, ездишь, ездит, ездим, ездите, ездят. Past: ездил / ездила / ездило / ездили.
The 1sg of ездить is езжу: the д becomes ж before the у ending. The other present forms keep -зд-.
Choose ехать for сейчас, потом, скоро, and one specific trip; choose ездить for часто, обычно, каждый день, иногда, and completed round-trips.
Name the means of transport with 'на + prepositional': на автобусе, на машине, на поезде, на метро, на такси, на самолёте.
examples: Сейчас Маша едет в Москву на поезде. (Right now Masha is on her way to Moscow by train.) Ехать: in-progress one-way trip.
Лена часто ездит на дачу на машине. (Lena often goes to the dacha by car.) Ездить with 'часто': habit.
Антон вчера ездил в Петербург и вернулся вечером. (Anton went to Petersburg yesterday and returned in the evening.) Ездить past: round-trip.
Когда мы ехали на автобусе, начался дождь. (While we were riding the bus, it started raining.) Ехать past: motion in progress.
Я езжу на работу на метро каждый день. (I take the metro to work every day.) Ездить with 'каждый день': habit; 1sg езжу.
Этот поезд едет в Петербург. (This train is going to Petersburg.) Ехать: a single ongoing trajectory.

tables.title: Motion by Transport: One-Way vs Round-Trip / Habit

items.prompt: Сейчас Маша _____ в Москву на поезде.
items.promptEnglish: Right now Masha is on her way to Moscow by train.
items.hint: 'Сейчас' anchors the action to this moment. Single one-way trip by transport?
items.explanation: 'Сейчас' (right now) marks a single in-progress one-way trip. By transport (на поезде) → ехать, 3sg едет. Ездит would describe a habit ('she goes to Moscow regularly'), which the present-moment cue rules out. Ходит is the on-foot verb, wrong with на поезде.

items.prompt: Лена часто _____ на дачу на машине.
items.promptEnglish: Lena often goes to the dacha by car.
items.hint: 'Часто' is a habit cue. Repeated trips by transport need which verb of the pair?
items.explanation: 'Часто' (often) marks repeated motion. Repetition + by transport → ездить, 3sg ездит. Едет would describe a single one-way trip in progress, not a recurring pattern.

items.prompt: Я _____ на работу на метро каждый день.
items.promptEnglish: I take the metro to work every day.
items.hint: 'Каждый день' is a habit cue. Note the 1sg form of ездить.
items.explanation: 'Каждый день' marks a daily routine. Habit + 1sg of ездить → езжу (the д becomes ж before the у). Еду would describe a single one-way trip happening at this moment, which the daily-routine frame rules out.

items.prompt: Антон вчера _____ в Петербург и вернулся вечером.
items.promptEnglish: Anton went to Petersburg yesterday and returned in the evening.
items.hint: Past trip there AND back is a round-trip. Which past form covers both legs?
items.explanation: The 'и вернулся вечером' clause confirms a completed there-and-back trip. Past round-trip → ездить, masc -ил: ездил. Ехал (past of ехать) describes the moment of motion only ('he was riding'), not the full round-trip.

items.prompt: Когда мы _____ на автобусе, начался сильный дождь.
items.promptEnglish: While we were riding the bus, heavy rain started.
items.hint: 'When we were riding' frames a moment within a single in-progress trip. Past plural?
items.explanation: 'Когда мы ехали' = 'while we were riding': a moment captured inside a single in-progress one-way trip. Past plural of ехать: ехали. Ездили would describe a completed round-trip, which cannot host the rain that interrupts the motion.

items.prompt: Этот поезд _____ прямо в Петербург, без остановок.
items.promptEnglish: This train goes straight to Petersburg, with no stops.
items.hint: One train on one trajectory toward one destination. One-way, in progress?
items.explanation: One train moving along one trajectory toward one destination is a single in-progress trip → ехать, 3sg едет. Ездит would suggest the train shuttles back and forth as a routine, which 'прямо ... без остановок' rules out.

items.promptEnglish: I go to university by metro every day.
items.hint: 'Каждый день' is a habit cue. Which member of the pair?
items.explanation: A daily habit takes the round-trip ездить: езжу (the д becomes ж in the 1sg). Еду is one trip in progress right now.

items.promptEnglish: Right now Lena is on her way to the airport by taxi.
items.hint: 'Сейчас' + one destination = one trip in progress.
items.explanation: A single in-progress trip takes the one-way ехать: едет. Ездит would mean she regularly rides there and back, which clashes with 'сейчас'.

items.promptEnglish: We often drive to the dacha.
items.hint: 'Часто' is a frequency cue. Which verb, 1pl?
items.explanation: Repeated trips take the round-trip ездить: ездим. Едем is one drive in progress.

hints: я: the trap form. The д turns into ж, so it is not «ездю»
explanations: езжу: 1sg of ездить. This is the only form where д becomes ж. «Ездю» does not exist.
ездишь: 2sg of ездить. Every form except the 1sg keeps -зд-: ездишь, ездит, ездим, ездите, ездят.
ездим: 1pl of ездить: езд- + -им, 'we go (regularly, by transport)'.
ездят: 3pl of ездить: езд- + -ят, the 2nd-conjugation ending, never «ездют».

blanks: Маша _____ в Петербург каждое лето. (Masha goes to Petersburg every summer.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Каждое лето' (every summer) is a habit cue: the trip recurs annually. Habit + by transport → ездить, 3sg ездит. Едет would describe a single in-progress trip, which the recurring-summer frame rules out.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Лена ездит на работу на автобусе.
sentenceBuilding.translation: Lena goes to work by bus.
acceptableVariants: Лена ездит на автобусе на работу.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Daily routine → ездить, 3sg. Add the destination, then 'на + transport' in the prepositional.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Мы каждое лето ездим на море на поезде.
sentenceBuilding.translation: Every summer we go to the sea by train.
acceptableVariants: Каждое лето мы ездим на море на поезде.
sentenceBuilding.hint: 'Каждое лето' is a habit cue → ездить, 1pl. Means of transport: на + prepositional.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Антон часто ездит в Москву на машине.
sentenceBuilding.translation: Anton often goes to Moscow by car.
acceptableVariants: Антон ездит в Москву на машине часто.

errorCorrection.sentence: Позвони мне позже: я сейчас езжу в аэропорт на такси.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Call me later: I'm on my way to the airport by taxi right now.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Сейчас' anchors a single one-way trip in progress, which is the job of ехать: еду. The round-trip езжу (1sg of ездить) describes a habit ('I regularly go to the airport'), which clashes with 'сейчас' and a single taxi ride. Choose ехать for one trip underway, ездить for routines and round-trips.

errorCorrection.sentence: Мы каждое утро едем на работу на метро.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Every morning we take the metro to work.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Каждое утро' is a frequency cue: the trip repeats daily, which is the round-trip verb ездить: ездим. The one-way едем describes one ride happening right now, which a daily routine is not. Ездили is the past round-trip form.

errorCorrection.sentence: В прошлом месяце Лена ехала в Петербург и вернулась через три дня.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Last month Lena went to Petersburg and came back three days later.
errorCorrection.explanation: The frame 'в прошлом месяце ... и вернулась' describes a completed there-and-back trip, which is the round-trip ездить past: ездила. The one-way ехала captures only a moment of riding ('was on her way'), not the whole trip.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I'm heading home by taxi right now.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Сейчас' (right now) forces a present-moment in-progress reading: single one-way trip → ехать, 1sg еду. Езжу would describe a habit (regular taxi rides home), which the present-moment cue rules out.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha goes to the dacha every weekend.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Каждые выходные' (every weekend) is a frequency cue: repetition → ездить, 3sg ездит. Едет would describe a single in-progress trip at this moment, which the recurring-weekend pattern rules out.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each sentence by the verb it needs: ехать (one in-progress trip) or ездить (habit or round-trip).

items.word: Сейчас я ___ в центр на метро.
Антон ___ на работу на машине каждый день.
Летом мы часто ___ на море на поезде.
Вчера Лена ___ в Москву и вернулась вечером.
Скоро поезд ___ в Петербург, садись скорее.

reviewVocab.definition: to go by transport, one-way and in progress (single trip happening at the reference moment, in one direction)
reviewVocab.example: Сейчас Маша едет в Москву на поезде.

reviewVocab.definition: to go by transport, round-trip or habit or general claim. 1sg is езжу (the д becomes ж before the у).
reviewVocab.example: Я езжу на работу на метро каждый день.

reviewVocab.definition: names the means of travel in the prepositional case: на поезде, на машине, на метро, на такси, на автобусе, на самолёте
reviewVocab.example: Лена часто ездит на дачу на машине.
